feat: switch to automatic JSX (#99)

* chore: bump vitest to latest

Upgrades vitest to the latest version and adds coverage just in case we
want to run with that locally.

This also means the vite config changes since it uses oxc now rather
than esbuild under the hood.

* feat: use automatic JSX internally

We already expose a `jsx-runtime` to be used with
`importSource: 'ultrahtml'`, but we don't use it ourselves.

This changes the tests and vite config to use the more modern
`importSource` rather than the classic style.

Since we had repeated code in the runtime entrypoint, it also drops that
and uses the existing `h` function.

---------
